title: Descent of a syntomic algebra map along a directed colimit of base rings
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed set and $(R_i)_{i\in I}$ a directed system of commutative rings, with compatible unital transition homomorphisms $R_i\to R_j$ for $i\leq j$, and colimit $R=\varinjlim_i R_i$ in commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix $i_0\in I$, commutative $R_{i_0}$-algebras $B_0,C_0$, and an $R_{i_0}$-algebra homomorphism $\varphi_0:B_0\to C_0$ of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. For $i\geq i_0$ set $B_i=R_i\otimes_{R_{i_0}}B_0$, $C_i=R_i\otimes_{R_{i_0}}C_0$, and let $\varphi_i=1\otimes\varphi_0:B_i\to C_i$; put $B=R\otimes_{R_{i_0}}B_0$, $C=R\otimes_{R_{i_0}}C_0$ and $\varphi=1\otimes\varphi_0:B\to C$. Assume that $\varphi$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], of finite presentation, and that for every prime $\mathfrak p\subset B$ its fibre ring $C\otimes_B\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is a local complete intersection over $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ [def-weil-pbc-complete-intersection-over-field]. Then there exists $i\geq i_0$ such that $\varphi_i$ is flat, of finite presentation, and for every prime $\mathfrak p_i\subset B_i$ the fibre ring $C_i\otimes_{B_i}\kappa(\mathfrak p_i)$ is a local complete intersection over $\kappa(\mathfrak p_i)$. No finite-presentation assumption on $R_{i_0}\to B_0$ or $R_{i_0}\to C_0$ is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0C33 (lemma-colimit-lci), syntomic case, with Tag 00SL (definition-lci) expanded as flat, finite presentation, and local-complete-intersection residue-field fibres.

proof.text: On the cofinal tail $i\geq i_0$, maps out of $R_i\otimes_{R_{i_0}}T_0$ ($T_0=B_0,C_0$) are pairs of ring maps agreeing on $R_{i_0}$ [lem-weil-pbc-algebra-tensor-pushout-universal-property], so these squares are pushouts and [lem-weil-pbc-limit-finite-presentation-colimits] gives $B=\varinjlim B_i$, $C=\varinjlim C_i$. The same holds on every tail $k\geq j$, and associativity gives $R_k\otimes_{R_j}B_j\cong B_k$, $R_k\otimes_{R_j}C_j\cong C_k$, and likewise with $R$. The formula $(r\otimes b)\otimes c\mapsto r\otimes\varphi_0(b)c$, inverse $r\otimes c\mapsto(r\otimes1)\otimes c$, gives $C_i\cong B_i\otimes_{B_0}C_0$. Thus every $B_i\to C_i$ is finitely presented by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-presentation-base-change-composition](1). All tails are small directed sets.

source.place: Tag 0C33 (lemma-colimit-lci), directed-colimit tensor notation; Tag 00R0 (lemma-limit-finite-presentation); Tag 05G5 (lemma-base-change-finiteness).

proof.text: For $\mathfrak q\subset C$, put $\mathfrak p=\varphi^{-1}\mathfrak q$. The local map $B_{\mathfrak p}\to C_{\mathfrak q}$ is flat by [lem-weil-pbc-flat-local-ring-maps]. In $F=C\otimes_B\kappa(\mathfrak p)$, $\mathfrak Q=\ker(F\to\kappa(\mathfrak q))$ lies in some $D(h)$ with $F_h$ a global complete intersection by [def-weil-pbc-complete-intersection-over-field]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-syntomic-at-prime-relative-global-complete-intersection]: its hypotheses (1)-(3) are the item's finite presentation with $g=1$, this local flatness and this $h\notin\mathfrak Q$. It gives $g_{\mathfrak q}\notin\mathfrak q$ with $B\to C_{g_{\mathfrak q}}$ a relative global complete intersection. By [lem-weil-pbc-spec-basic-opens-unit-ideal-quasi-compact](iii),(i), choose finitely many $g_a,h_a\in C$ with $\sum h_ag_a=1$ among these.

source.place: Tag 0C33 (lemma-colimit-lci), syntomic paragraph, first sentence; Tag 00SY (lemma-syntomic); Tag 00HT (lemma-flat-localization).

proof.text: By [lemma-nagata-filtered-colimit-finite-data], lift all $g_a,h_a$ to one $C_j$, $j\geq i_0$, with $\sum h_{j,a}g_{j,a}=1$; $g_{k,a},h_{k,a}$ are their images in $C_k$ ($k\geq j$). Put $D_{j,a}=(C_j)_{g_{j,a}}$. It is finitely presented over $B_j$: in a presentation $B_j[x]/(u)\cong C_j$ (Step 1), lift $g_{j,a}$ to $G$ and adjoin $t$ with $Gt-1$; $x_b\mapsto x_b/1$, $t\mapsto1/g_{j,a}$ is an isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. By [lem-weil-pbc-algebra-localization-away-base-change] and Step 1, $R_k\otimes_{R_j}D_{j,a}\cong(C_k)_{g_{k,a}}$ over $B_k$ and $R\otimes_{R_j}D_{j,a}\cong C_{g_a}$ over $B$, via $r\otimes(c/g^e)\mapsto(r\otimes c)/g^e$.

source.place: Tag 0C33 (lemma-colimit-lci), syntomic paragraph, lifting the generators and unit relation and forming principal localizations.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-relative-global-ci-ring-colimit-descent] to $(R_k)_{k\geq j}$, $i_0:=j$, and the finitely presented $B_j\to D_{j,a}$ (Step 3); by Steps 1 and 3 its limit map is $B\to C_{g_a}$, a relative global complete intersection by Step 2, and its stages are $B_k\to(C_k)_{g_{k,a}}$. Choose an upper bound $i$ of $j$ and the finitely many resulting stages; every $B_i\to(C_i)_{g_{i,a}}$ is a relative global complete intersection, and $\sum h_{i,a}g_{i,a}=1$ persists. For the empty cover take $i=j$, where this equation is $0=1$.

source.place: Tag 0C33 (lemma-colimit-lci), syntomic paragraph, application of the first proof paragraph to each chart and increase to a common index.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-relative-ci-principal-cover-syntomic-gluing] to this unit relation and these charts. With $A=B_i$, $D=C_i$, $g_a=g_{i,a}$, $h_a=h_{i,a}$ its conclusion is exactly the item's conclusion.

source.place: Tag 0C33 (lemma-colimit-lci), last sentence; Tag 00SO (lemma-local-syntomic) and Tag 00SW (lemma-relative-global-complete-intersection).
